rationale: The web-compat DesignIR emitter (generate_node in core/view/src/design_codegen.cpp) lowers a display:grid node with more than one column track and row auto-flow to a wrapped flex row instead of an unwrapped one; the web-compat runtime is flex-only, and authored heights pin flex-shrink to 0, so fixed-width cells overflowed. Single-column and column-flow grids emit exactly what they did before. Covered by a live-bounds Catch2 fixture in test_design_import_codegen_layout_text.cpp. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
